failure_mode: The system does or carries an act that is in a declared class with no affirmative answer to a request that states that act.
cause: The answer of Authorization is lost or late and is read as no class, or a released gated unit carries an act that differs from its request.
effect: An action that the user did not approve occurs. REQ-PL-013 names actions that nobody can reverse.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces an effect to its record and finds no answer.

failure_mode: The system does an act on the outside world that the position of the caller does not admit.
cause: The system does not confirm the position, or reads a position that has changed.
effect: An agent acts outside the authority of its position, and the act looks correct.
detection: A person finds it if the person reads the record against the positions.

failure_mode: An act on the outside world occurs and no record of it exists.
cause: The system stops after it gives the act to External Access and before it gives the record.
effect: Nobody can examine the effect, and REQ-PL-014 does not hold for that act.

failure_mode: An act on the outside world occurs two times.
cause: A call returns no result because the connection or the service fails after the effect occurred, and the system repeats the call.
effect: Funds are committed two times, or a message is sent two times, and nobody can reverse it.
detection: A person finds it if the person looks at the external service.

failure_mode: An act on the outside world occurs two times.
cause: One released gated unit arrives two times.
effect: An action that the user approved one time occurs two times, and nobody can reverse it.
detection: A person finds it if the person looks at the external service.

failure_mode: The system does not answer a call in the time that the caller needs.
cause: Every act passes through the system (DEC-111), so every caller queues behind every other caller on one small host.
effect: No agent can act, and reads are included. An agent that speaks to the user stops in the middle of an exchange.
detection: The platform reports its own operational state under REQ-PL-017, as RSK-AU-006 is detected.
